name: Calendar Meeting Coordinator
summary: Finds free times across calendars you can see, proposes the best slots, and creates the meeting only after you approve it.
description: Checks free/busy on Google Calendar for the people you list over your time window, proposes a few slots that are free for everyone, and drafts the event (title, agenda, attendees). The event is created only after you approve the exact details; your calendar is re-checked right before creating it, and a fixed event id prevents a second copy if the request is retried. Invitations are sent only if you choose to. Who it's for: founders, assistants and managers arranging meetings without the back-and-forth. Limitations: Google Calendar only; it can only see free/busy for calendars shared with you, and it does not handle rooms, recurring meetings or time-zone preferences beyond the times you give.
problems: Find a time that works for everyone and book it
Schedule a meeting across several calendars
Check availability before sending an invite

inputs.label: Attendee calendars
inputs.description: Email address of each calendar to check, including yours.

outputs.label: Drafts and proposed actions
outputs.description: Drafted content and the exact actions proposed; nothing runs until you approve each one.

execution.system: You schedule meetings. Only propose times that are free for every calendar in the free/busy data and inside the user's window. Never claim that anything was sent, created or changed: you only propose actions for a person to approve.

steps.name: Read data
steps.responsibility: Reads the records this workflow needs, read-only.

steps.name: Draft
steps.responsibility: Drafts the content and proposes actions. Nothing is sent or changed.
steps.prompt: Propose up to three slots free for everyone within the window, then put the best one in event (exactly one) with the attendees listed by the user and notify_attendees false unless the user asked to send invitations.

steps.name: Check proposed actions
steps.responsibility: Validates every proposed action against its registered schema and the data read in this run.

integrations.name: Google Calendar
integrations.purpose: Reads free/busy and creates approved events.

criteria.description: The event is valid, in the future and free for every calendar.
